outcome: Projects select framework packs and track obligation lifecycle
acceptance: the catalog lists NIST CSF 2.0, OWASP ASVS, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001 framework packs
a project can select a framework pack version
custom control packs can be added for internal baselines and customer audits
old control pack versions remain available after a newer version is added
an obligation stores id, title, jurisdiction, source, applicability reason, owner, reviewer, dates, status, and linked controls
a project can register regional laws, industry rules, internal policies, customer contracts, and certification programs
obligations link to WorkItems, acceptance criteria, data categories, user roles, source documents, controls, risks, checks, and evidence
reviewer approval is required before an obligation can become enforcement policy
WorkItems can be flagged for regulated data, authentication, authorization, audit, retention, AI output, payment, security, privacy, or availability
controls map to WorkItems, checks, code evidence, CI reports, manual approvals, and audit events
certification readiness is shown by Project, Milestone, and WorkItem
customers cannot select packs or approve obligations
inScope: built-in and custom versioned control packs
outOfScope: threat models, SLOs, provenance, and attestations
assumptions: WorkItem delivery evidence summaries already store obligation summaries and can block delivered
security, reliability, and trust gates stay in the next D row
